description: A `modules` table in a package's own manifest is refused rather than overwritten. Emit writes only marks it verified against a body and an ambient `declare module` block has none, so no run could produce that table — and `--check` telling the reader to run emit would be telling them to delete it. Both paths refuse, and the `nonesuch` entry emit would never write is still there afterwards, which is how the case says the file was left alone rather than rewritten.

names: was not written: it holds a `modules` table
no run of emit could produce that table and writing this file would discard it
